fullPassage: Many birds winter in warmer climates ― many of which happen to be coffee-producing countries ― nesting in plantation trees planted to shade the coffee from too much direct sunlight. These same trees offer birds seasonal habitat. So bird-friendly coffee benefits coffee flavor and birds. It also means certification that a farm uses no synthetic chemicals. The cost of this certification is yield: a bird-friendly farm yields approximately one-third less per year. Lack of such a label, however, does not automatically mean the coffee is unfriendly to birds or of poorer quality. There are other ways to shade coffee trees besides trees. Mountainsides offer similar shade benefits, and some geographic regions feature natural cloud cover. So although being bird-friendly is generally favorable, it's not a conclusive quality indicator.

❌ ④ indicator: 지표/표시, 생산량 정의와 다름
det.tip: yield = 수확량/산출량(농작물이나 제품의 생산 총량)

questions.passage: Many birds winter in warmer climates ― many of which happen to be coffee-producing countries ― __________ (nest) in plantation trees planted to shade the coffee from too much direct sunlight.

Many birds winter in warmer climates ― many of which happen to be coffee-producing countries ― __________ (nest) in plantation trees.

det.korean: nest(동사원형) → nesting(현재분사): 주절 앞 분사구문, 새들이 둥지를 틀면서 겨울을 나는 동시 상황 묘사.
det.analysis: 분사구문 = 주어(Many birds)와 같은 주어 → 능동 현재분사 nesting. '~하면서'의 동시 행위.
det.tip: 분사구문 (동시동작): 능동 → 동사원형 + -ing. birds nest → nesting.

being bird-friendly is generally __________ (favor)

det.korean: favor(동사원형) → favorable(형용사): be동사 보어 자리 + 부사 generally의 수식 대상 → 형용사 형태로 변환.
det.analysis: is generally + 형용사(보어) → favorable. favor(v.) → favorable(adj.) 어형 변환. 접미사 -able 추가.

questions.passage: Many birds winter in warmer climates ― many of which happen to be coffee-producing countries ― nesting in plantation trees planted to shade the coffee from too much direct sunlight. These same trees offer birds seasonal habitat. So bird-friendly coffee benefits coffee flavor and birds. It also means certification that a farm uses __________. The cost of this certification is yield: a bird-friendly farm yields approximately one-third less per year. Lack of such a label, however, does not automatically mean the coffee is unfriendly to birds or of poorer quality. There are other ways to shade coffee trees besides trees. Mountainsides offer similar shade benefits, and some geographic regions feature natural cloud cover. So although being bird-friendly is generally favorable, it's not a conclusive quality indicator.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: no synthetic chemicals(합성 화학물질 없음) — 조류 친화적 인증이 보증하는 구체적 내용. 농장이 인공 화학물질을 전혀 사용하지 않는다는 것.
det.analysis:
❌ ① high crop production: 높은 작물 생산, 실제로 1/3 적게 생산하므로 반대
❌ ② minimal water usage: 물 사용 최소화, 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ③ certified organic farming: 유기농 인증, 원문의 구체적 표현이 아님
✅ ④ no synthetic chemicals: 원문 일치 — certification that a farm uses no synthetic chemicals
det.tip: 조류 친화적 인증 = no synthetic chemicals(합성 화학물질 미사용) 보증.

questions.passage: Many birds winter in warmer climates ― many of which happen to be coffee-producing countries ― nesting in plantation trees planted to shade the coffee from too much direct sunlight. The cost of this certification is yield: a bird-friendly farm yields approximately one-third less per year. Lack of such a label, however, does not automatically mean the coffee is unfriendly to birds or of poorer quality. There are other ways to shade coffee trees besides trees. Mountainsides offer similar shade benefits, and some geographic regions feature natural cloud cover. So although being bird-friendly is generally favorable, it's not __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a conclusive quality indicator(결정적인 품질 지표) — 조류 친화적이라는 것이 품질을 결정짓는 절대적 기준이 아니라는 결론. 빈칸 앞 'not'과 결합하여 '결정적 지표가 아니다'는 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the only way to grow coffee: 커피 재배의 유일한 방법, 본문의 결론 구조와 불일치
❌ ② a guarantee of higher profits: 높은 수익 보장, 실제로 수확량이 1/3 줄어 수익 감소
❌ ③ an obstacle to certification: 인증 장애물, 논리 역전
✅ ④ a conclusive quality indicator: 원문 일치 — it's not a conclusive quality indicator
det.tip: it's not a conclusive quality indicator — 조류 친화적이라고 해서 품질이 반드시 좋다고 단정 못 한다.
